# Hand-Crafted Question Templates in Knowledge Base Question Generation: How Many Were Needed?

## Overview: The Direct Answer

The question of how many hand-crafted templates the authors had to create does not have a single, system-wide answer. The work reports two separate template counts, one for each of the two knowledge bases (KBs) used in evaluation.
